rows.grounds: third singular active present/optative of root pūj

items.question: How should the maṇḍala be worshipped after the prior rites are completed?
items.inference: After making the maṇḍala as before, one should worship it by the previous path.
uncertainties: pūrvavartmanā may mean previous path or previous method.
items.plain_english: Having made the maṇḍala as before, one should worship it by the previous method.
